decision: The ticket was closed as completed on an unverified provider claim. The only evidence of work is an untrusted one-line email from Juniper Surveying (event-020); no appointment was ever confirmed with the tenant, no quote was submitted or approved despite the brief requiring approval before proceeding (event-010), no invoice is on file, and the landlord confirmation flagged at event-024 never arrived. I sent reversible verification requests to the tenant (ACT-1) and the provider (ACT-2) and logged the conflict (ACT-3). Whether the closure stands and whether an invoice for unverified work is paid or passed to the landlord is a human decision (RTE-STAFF, ESC-UNCONFIRMED), so the case goes to the property manager.
recap: Balcony door lock job closed on an unverified contractor claim with no invoice, no confirmed visit and no landlord sign-off; verification sent, referred to PM.
next_step: Property manager to decide whether to reopen the ticket and withhold the invoice, pending the tenant's confirmation that the lock works and Juniper Surveying's invoice/photos (both requested, 3-working-day window).

## Initial request
The tenant has reported that the locking mechanism on the glass door which leads out to the balcony is not turning / locking. Can you please get in touch with them to schedule a date and time to attend the property and quote to have the issue resolved. Thank you.

input.message: Dear Theo Ingram, regarding the balcony door lock at Flat 20, 110 Meadow Row. Our provider has told us the repair has been carried out. Before we close our file, please can you confirm: (1) did anyone attend the property for this lock, and on what date; (2) does the balcony door now lock correctly? If nobody has attended, or the lock is still not turning, please reply and we will re-book a visit at a time that suits you. In the meantime, if the door cannot be locked, please keep it closed and secured and do not leave the flat relying on that door for security.
